alkaline.note: a fresh cell reads 1.5-1.6 V; 2 cells: fresh 2.95 V, step 0.25 V (the detection rules, docs/detection.md)

alkaline-button.note: LR44: small capacity, flat curve until a late knee (assumed)

lithium-coin.note: CR20xx: 3.0-3.2 V fresh, 2.4 V is HmIP's default limit (FCI1)

lithium-aa.note: Li-FeS2 AA/AAA (Energizer Ultimate): 1.7-1.8 V fresh; set per device by the user

nimh.note: NiMH: 1.35-1.4 V fresh off the charger, flat curve; 2 cells: fresh 2.6 V, step 0.12 V

lead.note: per cell of a 12 V lead pack (6 cells): 12.6 V full, HM-Sec-SFA-SM's limit 10.5 V
